This is my daily Sun-Fri meal schedule, Saturday is a cheat and food prep day.

Breakfast 12pm

  • 4 oz of salmon fillet, season with black pepper, salt, various spices on hand, toss with panko bread crumbs and fry in a small skillet containing 1 Tbsp refined coconut oil

  • 4 oz frozen broccoli spears, season with black pepper and salt, toss in with the fish and brown, squeeze out the oil from the floret tops and save oil and dirty pan for lunch (the left over bits add flavor to the next dish)

  • 1 cup kefir

Lunch 3pm

  • 4 oz cut/chopped/sliced various veggies (broccoli, carrots, shittake, snap peas, watercress in a can, bell peppers, onion, etc.) seasoned lightly and tossed into frying pan used for cooking breakfast

  • 2 oz of whole wheat pasta (weighed dry)

  • 2 oz of chicken breast (weighed pre-cooked) cooked with red onion (usually 2 small or one very large red onion per 6 chicken portions) and cilantro (usually one bunch per 6 portions)

Dinner 6pm

  • 2 oz by volume (measured pre-cooked) steel cut oats cooked for 13 minutes, pinch of salt.

  • 1 egg (counted pre-hatched) cracked into oats after cooking them, mixed quickly, covered, and let sit for 5-10 minutes (stove is off)

  • 1 apple

 

All in all, about 1,200-1,400 calories. On top of the food I supplement with CLA, but nothing else. I drink water, black coffee, and occasionally green tea with a tsp or two of honey. I'm just a little concerned because I've been on it for 3+ months now and am not really seeing any progress, weight loss wise. Any feedback would be appreciated.
